invoice.title: Purchase invoices
invoice.intro: Supplier invoices checked against purchase orders and receipts. A matched invoice is not in payables until it is posted.

filterIssue.range: The end date must not be earlier than the start date.
filterIssue.supplier: Supplier ID must be a positive whole number.
filterIssue.order: Purchase order ID must be a positive whole number.

invoice.loadFailed: Could not load purchase invoices. Try again.
invoice.searchEmpty: No purchase invoices match these filters.

stateHint.draft: Saved but not yet matched against the order and receipts.
stateHint.matched: Matched within tolerance. Not yet posted to payables.
stateHint.disputed: Price or tax differs from the order. Each difference needs an accept or reject decision.
stateHint.rejected: Rejected. It will not be matched or posted.
stateHint.posted: Posted to payables. It can no longer be changed.

invoice.noHistory: No difference decisions have been made.
invoice.confirmMatch: Match this invoice against its order and receipts?
invoice.matchExplanation: Each line is compared with the order price and tax, and the invoiced quantity is reserved on the receipt lines. Nothing is posted to payables.
invoice.matchedMatched: Invoice {{number}} matched. It is not yet posted to payables.
invoice.matchedDisputed: Invoice {{number}} has price or tax differences. Accept or reject each difference below.
invoice.noDifferences: The differences cannot be shown because the order or receipt data has changed. Reload the invoice; if this persists, ask an administrator to check the source documents.
invoice.resolveHint: Accept or reject each difference and give a reason. Accepting all matches the invoice; rejecting any returns it to Draft.
invoice.resolvePermission: You can view these differences, but deciding them needs the resolve permission.
invoice.resolveAcceptExplanation: All differences are accepted, so the invoice becomes Matched. It is still not posted to payables. Decisions cannot be changed later.
invoice.resolveRejectExplanation: At least one difference is rejected, so the invoice returns to Draft and its reserved receipt quantity is released. Decisions cannot be changed later.
invoice.resolvedMatched: Decisions saved. Invoice {{number}} is matched but not yet posted to payables.
invoice.resolvedDraft: Decisions saved. Invoice {{number}} is back in Draft and its reserved quantity was released; revise the invoice before matching again.

resolveIssue.reason: Enter a reason of 1 to 500 characters.
resolveIssue.reasonLength: The reason must be 500 characters or fewer.

invoice.exportScope: Exports the saved lines of the invoices matching the applied filters and sort, one row per line, in the current language.
invoice.exportBusy: Export in progress. Wait for it to finish.
invoice.exportWaitLoad: Wait for the invoice list to finish loading.
invoice.exportNeedsList: Load the invoice list successfully before exporting.
invoice.exportNoRows: No invoices match the applied filters, so there is nothing to export.
invoice.exportNoInvoices: There are no purchase invoices yet, so there is nothing to export.
invoice.exportEmpty: No invoice lines match the applied filters. No file was downloaded.
invoice.exportIncomplete: The export file was incomplete or its row count did not match. No file was downloaded; retry.
invoice.exportDenied: You do not have permission to export purchase invoices (company-wide export permission is required).
invoice.exportInvalid: The export filters are invalid. Check the dates, status, supplier and order IDs and try again.
invoice.exportFailed: The export failed. Retry; if it fails again, give the trace ID to support.
invoice.exportTimeout: The export timed out. No file was downloaded; check your connection and retry.
invoice.postExplanation: This creates an accounts payable item and a journal entry for {{amount}} {{currency}} and moves the reserved receipt quantity to invoiced. A posted invoice can no longer be revised or matched; corrections need a debit or credit note from Finance.
invoice.posted: Invoice {{number}} was posted to accounts payable (payable #{{payable}}, journal #{{journal}}).
invoice.postedReplayed: Invoice {{number}} had already been posted (payable #{{payable}}, journal #{{journal}}); nothing was written again.

filterIssue.range: The end date must not be earlier than the start date.
filterIssue.supplier: Supplier ID must be a positive whole number.
filterIssue.source: Requisition line ID must be a positive whole number.

order.loadFailed: Could not load purchase orders. Try again.
order.searchEmpty: No purchase orders match these filters.
order.exportScope: Exports every saved line of the orders matching the applied filters and sort, one row per line, in the current language.
order.exportBusy: Export in progress. Wait for it to finish.
order.exportWaitLoad: Wait for the order list to finish loading.
order.exportNeedsList: Load the order list successfully before exporting.
order.exportNoRows: No orders match the applied filters, so there is nothing to export.
order.exportNoOrders: There are no purchase orders yet, so there is nothing to export.
order.exportEmpty: No order lines match the applied filters. No file was downloaded.
order.exportIncomplete: The export file was incomplete or its row count did not match. No file was downloaded; retry.
order.exportDenied: You do not have permission to export purchase orders (export and view permissions are both required).
order.exportInvalid: The export filters are invalid. Check the dates, status, supplier and requisition line and try again.
order.exportFailed: The export failed. Retry; if it fails again, give the trace ID to support.
order.exportTimeout: The export timed out. No file was downloaded; check your connection and retry.

actionHint.pending: Waiting for approval. The approver decides in the approval inbox; no other action is available now.
actionHint.cancelled: This order is cancelled. No further action is possible.
actionHint.rejected: A rejected order must be revised and saved before it can be submitted again.
actionHint.empty: Add at least one line before submitting.

order.submitExplanation: The ordered quantity of every source requisition line is reserved now. If any line lacks approved quantity, nothing is submitted. Without approval steps the order is approved immediately.
order.submittedPending: Purchase order {{number}} was submitted and is waiting for approval.
order.submittedApproved: Purchase order {{number}} was submitted and approved immediately (no approval steps).
order.deleteExplanation: The order disappears from the list. Its number is kept and never reused; requisition quantities are not changed.
order.cancelHelp: Cancelling releases the reserved requisition quantity once. The approval history, number and lines are kept.

reasonIssue.length: The reason must be at most {{max}} characters.

order.cancelExplanation: The order becomes Cancelled and its requisition quantity is released for other orders. This cannot be undone.
order.cancelled: Purchase order {{number}} was cancelled and its requisition quantity released.

form.sourceOver: Above the remaining requisition quantity {{remaining}}. The draft can be saved, but submission will be refused.
form.sourceDropped: The requisition source was removed because it is for a different item.
form.name: Name
form.amountNote: Amounts and tax are calculated by the system for the currency when saved, and shown on the order detail.
form.minLine: A purchase order needs at least one line.
form.contextHint: Choose the business date first to load currencies and input tax rates.
form.contextLoading: Loading currencies and input tax rates…
form.staleTax: The input tax rate of line {{lines}} is not valid on the new business date and was cleared. Choose a rate again.
form.staleCurrency: The previous currency is not active on the new business date and was cleared. Choose a currency again.
form.saved: Purchase order {{number}} saved as a draft (lines: {{count}}).
form.invalidForm: Some fields need attention. The purchase order was not saved.
form.notSaved: The purchase order was not saved; nothing changed.
form.invalidSource: The requisition source of some lines is no longer an approved requisition line for the same item. Choose those sources again.
form.serverFieldInvalid: The server rejected this value. Check it and save again.

issue.remark: Remark can have at most {{max}} characters.
issue.lines: A purchase order needs 1 to {{max}} lines.
issue.quantity: Enter a quantity above 0 with up to 13 digits and 6 decimal places.
issue.unitPrice: Enter a unit price of 0 or more with up to 13 digits and 6 decimal places.
